name: M-HalDetect
description: M-HalDetect is a multimodal hallucination detection dataset with 16k fine-grained annotations on VQA examples, designed to train and benchmark models for detecting and preventing hallucinations in large vision-language models.
reputation: A recent multimodal hallucination benchmark used in vision-language research, but still relatively new and not yet broadly standardized.
notes: First comprehensive dataset annotating object, entity, and relationship hallucinations; enables training of reward models to reduce hallucinations.
